items.title: In Gorkha’s flood-hit villages, even cooking a meal is a struggle
items.blurb: The Budhigandaki flood destroyed homes and disrupted road links, leaving families dependent on limited helicopter deliveries for food and other essentials.

items.title: Baglung flood survivors face Dashain without homes as rebuilding stalls
items.blurb: Families in Baglung are living in a cooperative building, relatives’ homes and a buffalo shed after floods swept away their houses and farmland. Many struggle to secure land and meet government requirements for…

items.title: Tourist arrivals in Mustang plunge 41.5 percent
items.blurb: Floods, heavy rain and prolonged closure of the Beni-Jomsom road disrupt access to the Himalayan district during the autumn tourism season.

items.title: Nepal set Oman 281-run target after Paudel-Airee rescue act
items.blurb: Their record 139-run fourth-wicket stand helped Nepal recover from an early collapse in a must-win Cricket World Cup League 2 match.

items.title: How Nepal played a big role in South Africa’s liberation
items.blurb: Anil Sooklal, South Africa’s top envoy to Nepal, on apartheid-era solidarity, climate justice after the Rasuwa flood, and why Kathmandu and Cape Town should be twinned.

items.title: Three years after quake, survivors in Karnali still face Dashain in temporary shelters
items.blurb: Delayed damage assessments and slow grant processing have delayed home reconstruction in Jajarkot, Rukum West, and Salyan.

items.title: For Saptari’s fire-hit families, there is little to celebrate this Dashain
items.blurb: With their homes and belongings reduced to ashes, families in Badgama and Mainakaderi are relying on emergency aid while facing the daunting cost of rebuilding.

items.title: Can Nepal’s hydropower boom withstand a changing Himalaya?
items.blurb: As floods and landslides expose the vulnerabilities of hydropower projects, Nepal’s push to generate 30,000 MW by 2035 raises urgent questions about safety, sustainability and who benefits from the country’s rivers.
